items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: His name was Tony something. I've got it written down, but I couldn't remember the last name.

ctx.x: His name was Tony something. I've got it written down, but I couldn't remember the last name. He says, 'Let me try this introduction.' And he took his banjo, after trying a lot of things: [SINGS REFRAIN OF Hello Dolly INTRODUCTION], and he laid it down like that. You know the introduction to the song. So they dubbed it in.
Oh, after the record they put this...
